en.headline: Law says she is confident Hong Kong will reach 53.8 million visitors this year
en.dek: The culture, sports and tourism secretary cited double-digit growth in the first nine months and strong Golden Week arrivals, despite fewer short-haul visitors from higher fuel prices.
body: Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law said she remained confident that Hong Kong would receive 53.8 million visitors for the full year.

Speaking on a radio programme on Saturday, Law said the first nine months had already brought about 40.7 million arrivals, a double-digit increase on the same period last year. The National Day Golden Week saw more than 1.41 million mainland visitors, which she described as above both last year’s figures and earlier expectations.

She attributed part of the strength to the Mid-Autumn Festival falling in late September, when the Victoria Park lantern display was extended and drew about 730,000 visitors. She noted that higher fuel prices had reduced short-haul traffic from places such as Southeast Asia, while mainland and long-haul numbers had held up well.

Law said remaining events and exhibitions in the final quarter, together with major international meetings, should continue to support arrivals. She described the new Huanggang Port as a positive addition of choice for travellers and said the authorities would watch which crossings concert-goers used. She added that the goal was not only higher numbers but also greater value added from tourism.

zh.headline: 羅淑佩稱有信心全年訪港旅客達5380萬人次
zh.dek: 文化體育及旅遊局局長指首九個月錄得約4070萬人次、按年雙位數增長，國慶黃金周內地客超預期，惟短途市場受燃油價格影響。
body: 文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩表示，對全年訪港旅客能夠達到5380萬人次仍有信心。
羅淑佩周六在電台節目說，今年首九個月已有約4070萬人次訪港，較去年同期錄得雙位數增長。國慶黃金周有逾141萬人次內地旅客來港，數字高於去年及原先預期。
她指出，今年中秋節在九月下旬，維園特色綵燈會延長展期，吸引約73萬人次到訪，有助帶動客量。燃油價格上升令東南亞等短途旅客減少，但內地及長途旅客表現理想。
羅淑佩說，年尾仍有多場盛事、會展活動及大型國際會議，預料會繼續帶來旅客。她認為新皇崗口岸多一個選擇是好事，當局會觀察大型演唱會旅客使用哪個口岸出境。她強調，政府目標不只追求人數，也追求旅遊業對經濟的增加值。
